release.description: Adds Javadoc-fixing automation, improves workflow integrations, and standardizes tool naming.
release.action: Added the `fix-javadoc` act for automating Javadoc issue resolution.
Improved provider, reviewer, and Maven integration behavior used by the Javadoc-fixing workflow.
Standardized tool and parameter names on kebab-case format across the tool integrations.
